project_comments.note: Synthesis complete. All 3 WPs passed all 4 pipeline stages (implementation → qa → code-review → documentation) with 0 blocking issues. 24/24 acceptance criteria met. Key carry-forwards: (1) pre-existing run-log-server.test.ts 404 regression warrants a dedicated WP; (2) execute output line truncation is a low-priority improvement; (3) chunk-renderer.ts module split should be planned if file exceeds ~1500 lines or new rendering modes are added.

outcome_summary: Introduced `renderChunksToDialogue()` — a new pure TypeScript renderer in `mcp-server/gui/chunk-renderer.ts` — that transforms raw JSONL chunk files into a clean, chat-like Markdown dialogue view, replacing the previous verbose JSON-heavy format in both active `/rendered` API endpoints. All 3 work packages and 24 acceptance criteria were completed with 0 blocking issues, 77/77 chunk-renderer tests passing, and full backward compatibility with `renderChunksToMarkdown`. The primary carry-forward item is a pre-existing test failure in `run-log-server.test.ts` (`.meta.json` 404 handling) that should be addressed in a dedicated work package.
